summary: Custodial torture leading to death; standard: preponderance of probability; failure to produce arrestee before magistrate within 24h; torture proven via medical evidence and witness testimony; conviction upheld under IPC 304-II, 330, 331, 342, 343, 348, 354, 385, 387, 193, 201, 202, 203, 218 read with 34; acquittal under Section 201 confirmed; no challenge to custodial torture finding.
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed; conviction under Section 201 set aside; other convictions upheld; sentences confirmed.
